title: Creative Cuties Studio

services.name: Drop-In Tuesday 3:00pm class 9/15
services.desc: Designed with your little one in mind, our drop-in classes offer a one time guided, hands-on arts & crafts experience in a space created just for them. From child-sized tables to a cozy, creative environment, every detail is intentional-so they can explore freely and you can enjoy the moment together. All classes are for ages 0-5 - One toddler + one

blurb: Creative Cuties is a toddler-focused arts and crafts studio in Fort Myers, designed for children ages 0-5 and their grown-ups. We offer weekly guided art classes, pop-up events, and birthday parties in a cozy, beautifully styled space. Each class is designed to encourage creativity, fine motor development, and meaningful connection - without the mess at home.
